title: ‘Monday Night Football’ 2026-2027: How to Watch the New York Giants vs. Los Angeles Rams Game Live Online Free
summary: Watch the Giants take on the Rams on Monday, Sept. 21 — keep an eye out for possible Kendrick Lamar and Snoop Dogg sightings at the game too.

The end of the NFL week two, the league heads to Los Angeles for Monday Night Football . For the game, two NFC powerhouses going head-to-head to see which team is going to dominate the conference for the 2026-2027 season . Plus, there might be one or two celebrity sightings too.

How to Watch ‘Monday Night Football’ Live Online, at a Glance:

- Date: Sept. 21

- Network: ABC, ESPN

- Matchup: New York Giants vs. Los Angeles Rams

- Online Streaming: DirecTV , Fubo , Hulu + Live TV , Sling TV , ESPN Unlimited

Watch on DirecTV

When Does ‘Monday Night Football’ Start ?

For week two, Monday Night Football takes place on Monday (Sept. 21) with the New York Giants taking on the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. Kickoff is at 8:15 p.m. ET/5:15 p.m. PT.

What TV Network Features ‘Monday Night Football’?

In 2026, Monday Night Football broadcasts across two networks, ABC and ESPN. Meanwhile, the NFL game is available to livestream on ESPN Unlimited .

Which Celebrities Are Making Appearances ‘Monday Night Football’?

The NFL is known for celebrity sightings, so it’s likely there may be a number of famous actors, actresses and recording artists in attendance. Artists who have been known to appear at games in the past, include L.A. Rams fans Kendrick Lamar, Snoop Dogg, YG, Dr. Dre and others.

Where to Watch ‘Monday Night Football’ Online for Free

For cord-cutters, there are a few ways to watch Monday Night Football , if you don’t have cable, especially if you want to watch for free. DirecTV has a five-day free trial , while other streaming services, such as Fubo and Hulu + Live TV , also offer free trials, so you can watch the game for free.
